method: Each operator in isolation, same shape as network. CUDA graph with 10 sequential calls of this operator, median of 7 event-timed graph replays; 3 warmup replays. Flatten excluded.
limitations: Repeated inputs/weights are cache-friendly, unlike the full network. CUDA graphs suppress CPU dispatch, so these are diagnostic device times, not end-to-end latency. ReLU is in-place.
